method: Claude-written prompt -> design spec (BlenderSource/TownLife09/town10_shapes.py) -> Codex-style soft studio concept render of a throwaway blockout by BlenderSource/TownLife09/concept_render09.py. No AI image model was available in the cloud session; the prompts can be re-run with an image model.

images.name: 01_front.png
images.title: 正面
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Blender modeling reference for a xianxia (Chinese immortal-cultivation) open-world town kitchen, single game asset: 米糧麻袋 (GrainSacks). Design: Burlap sack pile: one open sack full of rice with a wooden scoop, two tied sacks lying beside it, and a blank paper label. Scale: Approx. 1.0 x 0.9 x 0.65 m; each sack 0.8 m long. Style: softly beveled stylized 3D game art matching the existing dondon town (warm cedar timber, blue-grey stone, celadon porcelain, red lacquer, restrained jade and ochre accents). View: straight front elevation, camera level, facing the -Y front, entire object visible on a light grey seamless studio background with soft contact shadow. No characters, no scenery, no text or lettering, no watermark.
